messages:
nina-cs: Ping — Orbis Health requests a temporary Brazil (sa-east-1) ACL pin + 200 qps for a 3h partner demo on Friday. They said this demo determines whether the renewal moves forward. Need network + SRE signoff. :warning:

hao-net: Can do ACL pin. Need the CIDRs, whether they want dedicated peering, and the exact UTC start/end window.

leo-sre: We can support 200 qps but prefer a staged ramp (50% first 10m). Please include auto-revoke and a rollback plan. We'll add monitors.

sylvia-support: Filed ticket CS-5220 and added the renewal-risk tag. I'll ping the customer infra contact for last-mile details.

nina-cs: Customer sent these details:
```json
{
  "cidrs": ["45.76.200.0/24", "45.76.201.0/24"],
  "start": "2026-07-02T15:00:00Z",
  "end": "2026-07-02T18:00:00Z",
  "requested_qps": 200,
  "purpose": "partner integration demo / renewal"
}
```

hao-net: ACLs queued to be applied to sa-east-1 edge and pinned to Orbis tenant. No dedicated peering requested. Will post when test is done.

finance-bot: Heads up: estimated incremental cost for the temporary burst ~ $120. If actual usage exceeds estimate, billing will notify owners.

leo-sre: Canary + monitors configured: p95 > 380ms alert, 5xx rate > 0.8% alert, token-burn >1.7x baseline anomaly. Rollback: immediate cutover to default pool after 3 consecutive 5m breaches. Autoscaler allowed short-term burst headroom.

ticket-bot: Ticket CS-5220 updated: region=sa-east-1, cidrs added, temp_qps=200, auto_revoke=2026-07-02T18:00:00Z. Assigned to hao-net, leo-sre.

sylvia-support: Noted in renewal tracker and preparing a 1-question post-demo feedback link to send to Orbis. Sales notified for potential expedited follow-up.

hao-net: ACLs applied. Test from 45.76.200.11 returned SYN/ACK. Propagation should finish in ~3 minutes.

nina-cs: Thanks all. I'll confirm with the customer and remind them we will revoke at window close. Sales will stand by for renewal outreach if demo succeeds. :crossed_fingers:
